SELECT accentity_id AS accentity_id, accsubject_direction AS accsubject_direction, project_id AS project_id, currtype_id AS currtype_id, inventory_org_id AS inventory_org_id
	, material_sort AS material_sort, material_id AS material_id, accbook_id AS accbook_id, profit_center_id AS profit_center_id, accperiodscheme AS accperiodscheme
	, ytenant_id AS ytenant_id, customer_id AS customer_id, customer_type_id AS customer_type_id, supplier_id AS supplier_id, period_id AS period_id
	, bank_account AS bank_account, fi_event_name AS fi_event_name, fi_event_id AS fi_event_id, period_code AS period_code, warehouse_id AS warehouse_id
	, busi_dept_id AS busi_dept_id, product_line_id AS product_line_id, cash_flow_main_item AS cash_flow_main_item, cost_item_id AS cost_item_id, accsubject_id AS accsubject_id
	, accentity_id_orgid AS accentity_id_orgid, debit_begin_of_period_amount, credit_begin_of_period_amount, debit_current_period_amount, credit_current_period_amount
	, debit_end_of_period_amount, credit_end_of_period_amount, debit_accumulate_of_year_amount, credit_accumulate_of_year_amount
	, first_value(debit_begin_of_period_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY partial_dim_with_year_md5 ORDER BY period_code) AS debit_begin_of_year_amount
	, first_value(credit_begin_of_period_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY partial_dim_with_year_md5 ORDER BY period_code) AS credit_begin_of_year_amount, debit_avg_accumulate_of_year_amount
	, credit_avg_accumulate_of_year_amount, partial_dim_md5, partial_dim_with_year_md5
FROM base_query_one

SELECT accentity_id AS accentity_id, accsubject_direction AS accsubject_direction, project_id AS project_id, currtype_id AS currtype_id, inventory_org_id AS inventory_org_id
	, material_sort AS material_sort, material_id AS material_id, accbook_id AS accbook_id, profit_center_id AS profit_center_id, accperiodscheme AS accperiodscheme
	, ytenant_id AS ytenant_id, customer_id AS customer_id, customer_type_id AS customer_type_id, supplier_id AS supplier_id, period_id AS period_id
	, bank_account AS bank_account, fi_event_name AS fi_event_name, fi_event_id AS fi_event_id, period_code AS period_code, warehouse_id AS warehouse_id
	, busi_dept_id AS busi_dept_id, product_line_id AS product_line_id, cash_flow_main_item AS cash_flow_main_item, cost_item_id AS cost_item_id, accsubject_id AS accsubject_id
	, accentity_id_orgid AS accentity_id_orgid, sum(current_and_begin_debit_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY partial_dim_md5 ORDER BY period_code) - current_debit_amount AS debit_begin_of_period_amount
	, sum(current_and_begin_credit_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY partial_dim_md5 ORDER BY period_code) - current_credit_amount AS credit_begin_of_period_amount
	, current_debit_amount AS debit_current_period_amount, current_credit_amount AS credit_current_period_amount, sum(current_and_begin_debit_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY partial_dim_md5 ORDER BY period_code) AS debit_end_of_period_amount
	, sum(current_and_begin_credit_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY partial_dim_md5 ORDER BY period_code) AS credit_end_of_period_amount
	, sum(current_and_acc_debit_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY partial_dim_with_year_md5 ORDER BY period_code) AS debit_accumulate_of_year_amount
	, sum(current_and_acc_credit_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY partial_dim_with_year_md5 ORDER BY period_code) AS credit_accumulate_of_year_amount
	, 12 * sum(current_and_acc_debit_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY partial_dim_with_year_md5 ORDER BY period_code) / substr(period_code, 6, 8) AS debit_avg_accumulate_of_year_amount
	, 12 * sum(current_and_acc_credit_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY partial_dim_with_year_md5 ORDER BY period_code) / substr(period_code, 6, 8) AS credit_avg_accumulate_of_year_amount
	, partial_dim_md5, partial_dim_with_year_md5
FROM (
	SELECT accentity_id AS accentity_id, accsubject_direction AS accsubject_direction, project_id AS project_id, currtype_id AS currtype_id, inventory_org_id AS inventory_org_id
		, material_sort AS material_sort, material_id AS material_id, accbook_id AS accbook_id, profit_center_id AS profit_center_id, accperiodscheme AS accperiodscheme
		, ytenant_id AS ytenant_id, customer_id AS customer_id, customer_type_id AS customer_type_id, supplier_id AS supplier_id, period_id AS period_id
		, bank_account AS bank_account, fi_event_name AS fi_event_name, fi_event_id AS fi_event_id, period_code AS period_code, warehouse_id AS warehouse_id
		, busi_dept_id AS busi_dept_id, product_line_id AS product_line_id, cash_flow_main_item AS cash_flow_main_item, cost_item_id AS cost_item_id, accsubject_id AS accsubject_id
		, accentity_id_orgid AS accentity_id_orgid
		, sum(CASE 
			WHEN bln_period_begin = '0'
				AND ((fi_app_id = '136'
						AND settle_redflush_type IN ('0', '2'))
					OR (send_gl_state = '0'
						AND gl_voucher_no IS NOT NULL))
			THEN debit_amount
			ELSE 0
		END) AS current_debit_amount
		, sum(CASE 
			WHEN (bln_period_begin = '0'
					AND ((fi_app_id = '136'
							AND settle_redflush_type IN ('0', '2'))
						OR (send_gl_state = '0'
							AND gl_voucher_no IS NOT NULL)))
				OR bln_period_begin = '1'
			THEN debit_amount
			ELSE 0
		END) AS current_and_begin_debit_amount
		, sum(CASE 
			WHEN bln_period_begin = '0'
				AND ((fi_app_id = '136'
						AND settle_redflush_type IN ('0', '2'))
					OR (send_gl_state = '0'
						AND gl_voucher_no IS NOT NULL))
			THEN credit_amount
			ELSE 0
		END) AS current_credit_amount
		, sum(CASE 
			WHEN (bln_period_begin = '0'
					AND ((fi_app_id = '136'
							AND settle_redflush_type IN ('0', '2'))
						OR (send_gl_state = '0'
							AND gl_voucher_no IS NOT NULL)))
				OR bln_period_begin = '1'
			THEN credit_amount
			ELSE 0
		END) AS current_and_begin_credit_amount
		, sum(CASE 
			WHEN (bln_period_begin = '0'
					AND ((fi_app_id = '136'
							AND settle_redflush_type IN ('0', '2'))
						OR (send_gl_state = '0'
							AND gl_voucher_no IS NOT NULL)))
				OR period_begin_type = '1'
			THEN debit_amount
			ELSE 0
		END) AS current_and_acc_debit_amount
		, sum(CASE 
			WHEN (bln_period_begin = '0'
					AND ((fi_app_id = '136'
							AND settle_redflush_type IN ('0', '2'))
						OR (send_gl_state = '0'
							AND gl_voucher_no IS NOT NULL)))
				OR period_begin_type = '1'
			THEN credit_amount
			ELSE 0
		END) AS current_and_acc_credit_amount
		, partial_dim_md5, partial_dim_with_year_md5
	FROM base_view
	GROUP BY accentity_id, accsubject_direction, project_id, currtype_id, inventory_org_id, material_sort, material_id, accbook_id, profit_center_id, accperiodscheme, ytenant_id, customer_id, customer_type_id, supplier_id, period_id, bank_account, fi_event_name, fi_event_id, period_code, warehouse_id, busi_dept_id, product_line_id, cash_flow_main_item, cost_item_id, accsubject_id, accentity_id_orgid, partial_dim_md5, partial_dim_with_year_md5
) a

	, material_sort AS material_sort, material_id AS material_id, accbook_id AS accbook_id, profit_center_id AS profit_center_id, accperiodscheme AS accperiodscheme

	, substr(period_code, 1, 7) AS period_code

	, accsubject_id AS accsubject_id, accentity_id_orgid AS accentity_id_orgid, settle_redflush_type AS settle_redflush_type, period_begin_type AS period_begin_type, gl_voucher_no AS gl_voucher_no
	, send_gl_state AS send_gl_state, fi_app_id AS fi_app_id, bln_period_begin AS bln_period_begin
	, md5(concat_ws('_', coalesce(accentity_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(accsubject_direction, 'NULL'), coalesce(project_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(currtype_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(inventory_org_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(material_sort, 'NULL'), coalesce(material_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(accbook_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(profit_center_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(accperiodscheme, 'NULL'), coalesce(ytenant_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(customer_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(customer_type_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(supplier_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(bank_account, 'NULL'), coalesce(fi_event_name, 'NULL'), coalesce(fi_event_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(warehouse_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(busi_dept_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(product_line_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(cash_flow_main_item, 'NULL'), coalesce(cost_item_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(accsubject_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(accentity_id_orgid, 'NULL'), coalesce(settle_redflush_type, 'NULL'), coalesce(period_begin_type, 'NULL'), coalesce(gl_voucher_no, 'NULL'), coalesce(send_gl_state, 'NULL'), coalesce(fi_app_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(bln_period_begin, 'NULL'), coalesce(substr(period_code, 1, 4), 'NULL'))) AS partial_dim_with_year_md5
	, md5(concat_ws('_', coalesce(accentity_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(accsubject_direction, 'NULL'), coalesce(project_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(currtype_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(inventory_org_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(material_sort, 'NULL'), coalesce(material_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(accbook_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(profit_center_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(accperiodscheme, 'NULL'), coalesce(ytenant_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(customer_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(customer_type_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(supplier_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(bank_account, 'NULL'), coalesce(fi_event_name, 'NULL'), coalesce(fi_event_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(warehouse_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(busi_dept_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(product_line_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(cash_flow_main_item, 'NULL'), coalesce(cost_item_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(accsubject_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(accentity_id_orgid, 'NULL'), coalesce(settle_redflush_type, 'NULL'), coalesce(period_begin_type, 'NULL'), coalesce(gl_voucher_no, 'NULL'), coalesce(send_gl_state, 'NULL'), coalesce(fi_app_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(bln_period_begin, 'NULL'))) AS partial_dim_md5
	, SUM(CASE 
		WHEN direction = '0' THEN amount
		ELSE 0
	END) AS debit_amount
	, SUM(CASE 
		WHEN direction = '1' THEN amount
		ELSE 0
	END) AS credit_amount
FROM (
	SELECT accentity_id, accsubject_direction, project_id, currtype_id, inventory_org_id
		, material_sort, material_id, accbook_id, profit_center_id, accperiodscheme
		, ytenant_id, customer_id, customer_type_id, supplier_id, period_id
		, bank_account, fi_event_name, fi_event_id
		, if(bln_period_begin = 1
			AND period_begin_type = 0, concat(LEFT(period_code, 4), '-01'), period_code) AS period_code
		, warehouse_id, busi_dept_id, product_line_id, cash_flow_main_item, cost_item_id
		, accsubject_id, accentity_id_orgid, amount, settle_redflush_type, period_begin_type
		, gl_voucher_no, send_gl_state, fi_app_id, bln_period_begin, direction
	FROM s_y7c56a23__dwd_fie_aai_voucher_detail
	WHERE 1 = 1
		AND ytenant_id = 'y7c56a23'
		AND dr = '0'
		AND period_code <= date_format(add_months(current_date(), 1), 'yyyy-MM')
) a
GROUP BY accentity_id, accsubject_direction, project_id, currtype_id, inventory_org_id, material_sort, material_id, accbook_id, profit_center_id, accperiodscheme, ytenant_id, customer_id, coalesce(send_gl_state, 'NULL'), coalesce(fi_app_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(bln_period_begin, 'NULL')))

SELECT accentity_id, accsubject_direction, project_id, currtype_id, inventory_org_id
	, material_sort, material_id, accbook_id, profit_center_id, accperiodscheme
	, ytenant_id, customer_id, customer_type_id, supplier_id, period_id
	, bank_account, fi_event_name, fi_event_id, period_code, warehouse_id
	, busi_dept_id, product_line_id, cash_flow_main_item, cost_item_id, accsubject_id
	, accentity_id_orgid, sum(debit_begin_of_period_amount) AS debit_begin_of_period_amount, sum(credit_begin_of_period_amount) AS credit_begin_of_period_amount
	, CASE 
		WHEN accsubject_direction = '0' THEN sum(debit_begin_of_period_amount) - sum(credit_begin_of_period_amount)
		ELSE sum(credit_begin_of_period_amount) - sum(debit_begin_of_period_amount)
	END AS balance_begin_of_period_amount, sum(debit_current_period_amount) AS debit_current_period_amount, sum(credit_current_period_amount) AS credit_current_period_amount
	, CASE 
		WHEN accsubject_direction = '0' THEN sum(debit_current_period_amount) - sum(credit_current_period_amount)
		ELSE sum(credit_current_period_amount) - sum(debit_current_period_amount)
	END AS balance_current_period_amount, sum(debit_end_of_period_amount) AS debit_end_of_period_amount, sum(credit_end_of_period_amount) AS credit_end_of_period_amount
	, CASE 
		WHEN accsubject_direction = '0' THEN sum(debit_end_of_period_amount) - sum(credit_end_of_period_amount)
		ELSE sum(credit_end_of_period_amount) - sum(debit_end_of_period_amount)
	END AS balance_end_of_period_amount, sum(debit_accumulate_of_year_amount) AS debit_accumulate_of_year_amount, sum(credit_accumulate_of_year_amount) AS credit_accumulate_of_year_amount
	, CASE 
		WHEN accsubject_direction = '0' THEN sum(debit_accumulate_of_year_amount) - sum(credit_accumulate_of_year_amount)
		ELSE sum(credit_accumulate_of_year_amount) - sum(debit_accumulate_of_year_amount)
	END AS balance_accumulate_of_year_amount, sum(debit_begin_of_year_amount) AS debit_begin_of_year_amount, sum(credit_begin_of_year_amount) AS credit_begin_of_year_amount
	, CASE 
		WHEN accsubject_direction = '0' THEN sum(debit_begin_of_year_amount) - sum(credit_begin_of_year_amount)
		ELSE sum(credit_begin_of_year_amount) - sum(debit_begin_of_year_amount)
	END AS balance_begin_of_year_amount, sum(debit_avg_accumulate_of_year_amount) AS debit_avg_accumulate_of_year_amount, sum(credit_avg_accumulate_of_year_amount) AS credit_avg_accumulate_of_year_amount
	, CASE 
		WHEN accsubject_direction = '0' THEN sum(debit_avg_accumulate_of_year_amount) - sum(credit_avg_accumulate_of_year_amount)
		ELSE sum(credit_avg_accumulate_of_year_amount) - sum(debit_avg_accumulate_of_year_amount)
	END AS balance_avg_accumulate_of_year_amount
FROM base_query_two
GROUP BY accentity_id, accsubject_direction, project_id, currtype_id, inventory_org_id, material_sort, material_id, accbook_id, profit_center_id, accperiodscheme, ytenant_id, customer_id, customer_type_id, supplier_id, period_id, bank_account, fi_event_name, fi_event_id, period_code, warehouse_id, busi_dept_id, product_line_id, cash_flow_main_item, cost_item_id, accsubject_id, accentity_id_orgid

-- 先聚合, 再笛卡尔积
-- 用全排列的维度去关联原始数据，将金额补齐，没关联到的置0
-- 目的是之后用窗口函数计算期初期末的时候，保证最细粒度下，每个期间都有值，这样在后续汇总的时候才能保证窗口函数计算出来的数据能够被正确汇总 。
SELECT uuid() AS id, a.accentity_id AS accentity_id, a.accsubject_direction AS accsubject_direction, a.project_id AS project_id, a.currtype_id AS currtype_id
	, a.inventory_org_id AS inventory_org_id, a.material_sort AS material_sort, a.material_id AS material_id, a.accbook_id AS accbook_id, a.profit_center_id AS profit_center_id
	, a.accperiodscheme AS accperiodscheme, a.ytenant_id AS ytenant_id, a.customer_id AS customer_id, a.customer_type_id AS customer_type_id, a.supplier_id AS supplier_id
	, a.period_id AS period_id, a.bank_account AS bank_account, a.fi_event_name AS fi_event_name, a.fi_event_id AS fi_event_id, a.period_code AS period_code
	, a.warehouse_id AS warehouse_id, a.busi_dept_id AS busi_dept_id, a.product_line_id AS product_line_id, a.cash_flow_main_item AS cash_flow_main_item, a.cost_item_id AS cost_item_id
	, a.accsubject_id AS accsubject_id, a.accentity_id_orgid AS accentity_id_orgid, a.settle_redflush_type AS settle_redflush_type, a.period_begin_type AS period_begin_type, a.gl_voucher_no AS gl_voucher_no
	, a.send_gl_state AS send_gl_state, a.fi_app_id AS fi_app_id, a.bln_period_begin AS bln_period_begin
	, md5(concat_ws('_', coalesce(accentity_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(accsubject_direction, 'NULL'), coalesce(project_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(currtype_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(inventory_org_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(material_sort, 'NULL'), coalesce(material_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(accbook_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(profit_center_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(accperiodscheme, 'NULL'), coalesce(ytenant_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(customer_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(customer_type_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(supplier_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(bank_account, 'NULL'), coalesce(fi_event_name, 'NULL'), coalesce(fi_event_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(warehouse_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(busi_dept_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(product_line_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(cash_flow_main_item, 'NULL'), coalesce(cost_item_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(accsubject_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(accentity_id_orgid, 'NULL'))) AS partial_dim_md5
	, md5(concat_ws('_', coalesce(accentity_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(accsubject_direction, 'NULL'), coalesce(project_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(currtype_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(inventory_org_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(material_sort, 'NULL'), coalesce(material_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(accbook_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(profit_center_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(accperiodscheme, 'NULL'), coalesce(ytenant_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(customer_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(customer_type_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(supplier_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(bank_account, 'NULL'), coalesce(fi_event_name, 'NULL'), coalesce(fi_event_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(warehouse_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(busi_dept_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(product_line_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(cash_flow_main_item, 'NULL'), coalesce(cost_item_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(accsubject_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(accentity_id_orgid, 'NULL'), coalesce(substr(period_code, 1, 4), 'NULL'))) AS partial_dim_with_year_md5
	, coalesce(debit_amount, 0) AS debit_amount
	, coalesce(credit_amount, 0) AS credit_amount
FROM (
	-- 笛卡尔积，生成期间和剩余维度的排列组合
	SELECT a.accentity_id, a.accsubject_direction, a.project_id, a.currtype_id, a.inventory_org_id
		, a.material_sort, a.material_id, a.accbook_id, a.profit_center_id, a.accperiodscheme
		, a.ytenant_id, a.customer_id, a.customer_type_id, a.supplier_id, a.bank_account
		, a.fi_event_name, a.fi_event_id, a.warehouse_id, a.busi_dept_id, a.product_line_id
		, a.cash_flow_main_item, a.cost_item_id, a.accsubject_id, a.accentity_id_orgid, a.settle_redflush_type
		, a.period_begin_type, a.gl_voucher_no, a.send_gl_state, a.fi_app_id, a.bln_period_begin
		, b.period_code, period_id, a.partial_dim_md5
		, md5(concat_ws('_', coalesce(accentity_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(accsubject_direction, 'NULL'), coalesce(project_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(currtype_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(inventory_org_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(material_sort, 'NULL'), coalesce(material_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(accbook_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(profit_center_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(accperiodscheme, 'NULL'), coalesce(ytenant_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(customer_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(customer_type_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(supplier_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(bank_account, 'NULL'), coalesce(fi_event_name, 'NULL'), coalesce(fi_event_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(warehouse_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(busi_dept_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(product_line_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(cash_flow_main_item, 'NULL'), coalesce(cost_item_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(accsubject_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(accentity_id_orgid, 'NULL'), coalesce(settle_redflush_type, 'NULL'), coalesce(period_begin_type, 'NULL'), coalesce(gl_voucher_no, 'NULL'), coalesce(send_gl_state, 'NULL'), coalesce(fi_app_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(bln_period_begin, 'NULL'), coalesce(substr(period_code, 1, 4), 'NULL'))) AS partial_dim_with_year_md5
	FROM (
		-- 除了期间，剩余维度的枚举值
		SELECT a.accentity_id, a.accsubject_direction, a.project_id, a.currtype_id, a.inventory_org_id
			, a.material_sort, a.material_id, a.accbook_id, a.profit_center_id, a.accperiodscheme
			, a.ytenant_id, a.customer_id, a.customer_type_id, a.supplier_id, a.bank_account
			, a.fi_event_name, a.fi_event_id, a.warehouse_id, a.busi_dept_id, a.product_line_id
			, a.cash_flow_main_item, a.cost_item_id, a.accsubject_id, a.accentity_id_orgid, a.settle_redflush_type
			, a.period_begin_type, a.gl_voucher_no, a.send_gl_state, a.fi_app_id, a.bln_period_begin
			, partial_dim_md5, MAX(period_code) AS max_value, MIN(period_code) AS min_value
		FROM base_query a
		GROUP BY a.accentity_id, a.accsubject_direction, a.project_id, a.currtype_id, a.inventory_org_id, a.material_sort, a.material_id, a.accbook_id, a.profit_center_id, a.accperiodscheme, a.ytenant_id, a.customer_id, a.customer_type_id, a.supplier_id, a.bank_account, a.fi_event_name, a.fi_event_id, a.warehouse_id, a.busi_dept_id, a.product_line_id, a.cash_flow_main_item, a.cost_item_id, a.accsubject_id, a.accentity_id_orgid, a.settle_redflush_type, a.period_begin_type, a.gl_voucher_no, a.send_gl_state, a.fi_app_id, a.bln_period_begin, partial_dim_md5
	) a
		CROSS JOIN (
			SELECT period_code, period_id
			FROM (
				SELECT period_code, period_id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY period_code ORDER BY period_id) AS rn
				FROM base_query
			) a
			WHERE rn = 1
		) b
	WHERE b.period_code >= a.min_value
) a
	LEFT JOIN (
		-- 原始汇总表数据，用于取出度量字段
		SELECT period_code AS timeColumnName, coalesce(debit_amount, 0) AS debit_amount
			, coalesce(credit_amount, 0) AS credit_amount, partial_dim_md5
		FROM base_query
	) b
	ON a.partial_dim_md5 = b.partial_dim_md5
		AND a.period_code = b.timeColumnName

SELECT accentity_id AS details_accentity_id, accsubject_direction AS accsubject_direction, project_id AS details_project_id, currtype_id AS details_currtype_id, inventory_org_id AS org_inventory_id

	, CAST(debit_accumulate_of_year_amount AS decimal(38, 8)) AS year_to_date_dr, CAST(credit_accumulate_of_year_amount AS decimal(38, 8)) AS year_to_date_cr, CAST(balance_accumulate_of_year_amount AS decimal(38, 8)) AS year_to_date_balance, CAST(debit_begin_of_year_amount AS decimal(38, 8)) AS year_beginning_dr, CAST(credit_begin_of_year_amount AS decimal(38, 8)) AS year_beginning_cr
	, CAST(balance_begin_of_year_amount AS decimal(38, 8)) AS year_beginning_balance, CAST(debit_avg_accumulate_of_year_amount AS decimal(38, 8)) AS year_to_date_annu_dr, CAST(credit_avg_accumulate_of_year_amount AS decimal(38, 8)) AS year_to_date_annu_cr, CAST(balance_avg_accumulate_of_year_amount AS decimal(38, 8)) AS year_to_date_balance_annu
	, md5(concat_ws('_', md5(concat_ws('_', coalesce(accentity_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(accsubject_direction, 'NULL'), coalesce(project_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(currtype_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(inventory_org_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(material_sort, 'NULL'), coalesce(material_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(accbook_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(profit_center_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(accperiodscheme, 'NULL'), coalesce(ytenant_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(customer_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(customer_type_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(supplier_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(period_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(bank_account, 'NULL'), coalesce(fi_event_name, 'NULL'), coalesce(fi_event_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(period_code, 'NULL'), coalesce(warehouse_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(busi_dept_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(product_line_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(cash_flow_main_item, 'NULL'), coalesce(cost_item_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(accsubject_id, 'NULL'), coalesce(accentity_id_orgid, 'NULL'), coalesce('1970-01-01 00:00:00', 'NULL'))))) AS all_dimension_md5
